title: Uniform lower density-ratio bounds pass to the closure
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N, E ⊆ ℝ^N, c ∈ [0, ∞] and δ ∈ ℝ. Write densityRatio n μ z ρ = μ(B_ρ(z))/(ω_n ρ^n) in [0, ∞], where B_ρ(z) is the closed ball and ω_n = unitBallVolume n. Suppose c ≤ densityRatio n μ x ρ for every x ∈ E and every real ρ with 0 < ρ ≤ δ. Then c ≤ densityRatio n μ y ρ for every y in the closure of E and every real ρ with 0 < ρ ≤ δ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (E : Set (Euclidean N)) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (δ : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ δ → c ≤ densityRatio n μ x ρ) → ∀ y ∈ closure E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ δ → c ≤ densityRatio n μ y ρ
